        out["cpu"] = Dict("n_returned" => length(cpu),
                          "lengths" => [x isa AbstractArray ? length(x) : -1 for x in cpu])
    catch e
        out["cpu"] = Dict("error" => first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n")))
    end
    try
        gpu = initstacks_mg_vcycle_b_cuda(args...)
        out["gpu"] = Dict("n_returned" => length(gpu),
                          "types" => [string(typeof(x)) for x in gpu],
                          "lengths" => [x isa AbstractArray ? length(x) : -1 for x in gpu])
    catch e
        out["gpu"] = Dict("error" => first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n")))
    end
    out["device"] = CUDA.name(CUDA.device())
    println(JSON3.write(out))
end
main()
